methods.reduction: top-K extension argument with K = 1 + pair-constraint exclusions (K=2 for d != d', K=3 additionally for non-antipodal), K-grid enumerated exhaustively
methods.verification: full 62^4 materialised enumeration at every produced winner group and on 18 declared groups
methods.arithmetic: exact integers, units 1/120; numpy = integer accelerator

claims.name: COVERAGE: every party-1 ordered pair is processed by exactly one shard (3844 pairs, no duplicate, no omission), and the outer tuple count sums to 62^6 = 56,800,235,584
PARTY WINDOW: the party-window global extremes are computed directly (not by the round-4 sandwich) and reproduce round 4's raw-window global 512/120 exactly
EXACT GLOBAL EXTREMES OF THE EIGHT (all eight pairwise distinct) WINDOW: computed over all 62^6 outer groups with the exact integer machinery, achieved configuration recorded
EXACT GLOBAL EXTREMES OF THE ANTI_V3 (round-3 eight_anti semantics) WINDOW: computed over all 62^6 outer groups with the exact integer machinery, achieved configuration recorded
EXACT GLOBAL EXTREMES OF THE ANTI_STRICT (all eight pairwise non-antipodal) WINDOW: computed over all 62^6 outer groups with the exact integer machinery, achieved configuration recorded
EXACT GLOBAL EXTREMES OF THE RAW_FULL (no constraint at all, d = d' allowed) WINDOW: computed over all 62^6 outer groups with the exact integer machinery, achieved configuration recorded

WINDOW CHAIN: raw_full >= party >= eight >= anti_v3 >= anti_strict >= the round-3 pool values (480/320/224), every entry an exact number, so the round-4 brackets [320,512] and [224,512] are replaced by exact values
claims.detail: chain: raw_full 512 >= party 512 >= eight 512 >= anti_v3 512 >= anti_str 512 ; round-3 pool = {'raw': 480, 'party': 480, 'eight': 320, 'eight_anti': 224}

claims.name: WINNER VERIFICATION BY FOUR INDEPENDENT PATHS: for every window and both extreme sides the achieved configuration agrees with (i) the direct 8-term Mermin evaluation from the frozen s-index rule, (ii) an explicit window-membership check, (iii) the unfactorised four-term F/G expression, and (iv) a FULL 62^4 materialised enumeration of that group (no reduction at all) whose window extremes must equal the sharded global values
